title: Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. translated_title: 智能体被要求遗忘时能遗忘吗？面向大语言模型智能体记忆遗忘的基准测试
translated_abstract: 长期记忆已成为大语言模型（LLM）智能体的核心组成部分。随着智能体在长期使用过程中不断积累个人信息，用户越来越多地要求它们删除敏感或过时的事实。一个理想的记忆系统应当响应此类请求，即精确删除所要求的内容，同时保持其余记忆完好无损。然而，现有的记忆基准仅评估记忆的写入、检索与组织，因此智能体能否在用户明确要求下进行遗忘仍然缺乏充分评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了Bemula——首个专门针对记忆遗忘的基准测试。它包含50个多会话对话实例、135个六种类型的遗忘请求以及1,742个测试问题。每个对话均配有一个不含遗忘请求的对照版本，从而确保只有确实存储了目标信息的系统才能因成功遗忘而获得评分。通过这组成对的版本，五个测试套件对存储情况以及所请求信息的删除效果进行测量。
tldr: 本文提出首个面向LLM智能体记忆遗忘的基准Bemula，通过50个多会话对话、135个六类遗忘请求、1,742个测试问题以及带对照版本的配对设计，系统评估智能体能否按用户要求精确删除指定记忆并保持其余记忆完好。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning in LLM agents, comprising 50 multi-session dialogues, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions with paired control versions to evaluate whether agents can precisely remove requested memories while keeping the rest intact.
